chunks: From him, from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Muḥammad, from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, who said:
I prayed behind Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and he sought refuge aloud, then he recited aloud: “In the Name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abī ʿAbdillāh, a title of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ: the basmalah, recited at the opening of recitation
key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, indicating prayer in congregation behind an Imam
key_terms.فَتَعَوَّذَ: he sought refuge in Allah before recitation

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام recite the taʿawwudh and بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ aloud in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the prayer practice of Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام in reciting the seeking of refuge aloud and then pronouncing بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ aloud. It is relevant to discussions of the manner and audible elements of salat (prayer) recitation in Shia fiqh.
